item.title: Sample Page
item.dc:creator: webguys
item.content:encoded:
This is an example page. It's different from a blog post because it will stay in one place and will show up in your site navigation (in most themes). Most people start with an About page that introduces them to potential site visitors. It might say something like this:
Hi there! I'm a bike messenger by day, aspiring actor by night, and this is my website. I live in Los Angeles, have a great dog named Jack, and I like piña coladas. (And gettin' caught in the rain.)
...or something like this:
The XYZ Doohickey Company was founded in 1971, and has been providing quality doohickeys to the public ever since. Located in Gotham City, XYZ employs over 2,000 people and does all kinds of awesome things for the Gotham community.
As a new WordPress user, you should go to your dashboard to delete this page and create new pages for your content. Have fun!

item.title: About
item.dc:creator: webguys
item.content:encoded:
[vc_row row_type="row_full_center_content"][vc_column][vc_custom_heading text="America's Express Car Washing" font_container="tag:h3|font_size:28px|text_align:center|color:%23222222" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="nt-heading-line"][vc_empty_space height="50px"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row_full_center_content" margin_top="-150" css=".vc_custom_1473315710770{padding-bottom: 75px !important;}"][vc_column width="1/2"][vc_custom_heading text="Our Company" font_container="tag:h2|font_size:28px|text_align:center|color:%23111111" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=""][vc_column_text css=""]1997 Pro Wash started as a mobile car wash with one truck. The truck became immobile in a shopping center parking lot in Marlow Heights, where we negotiated space and continued providing services. Forced to close by the County in 1999 due to zoning regulations, we then secured our first location in Clinton, MD. Pro Wash later opened a second location in Capitol Heights, MD.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/2"][vc_custom_heading text="Our Reputation" font_container="tag:h2|font_size:28px|text_align:center|color:%23111111" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=""][vc_column_text css=""]"They did a great job!!!! Their guys definitely knows tinting windows. The price was really good and My car looks great. I highly recommend for tinting."[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=""]"Had such a great experience here. Everything was super easy, efficient, and they did great work! Price also fair . I will definitely be back!"[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row" css=".vc_custom_1505340980965{padding-top: 0px !important;padding-bottom: 0px !important;background-image: url(https://prowashdetail.net/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/car.jpg?id=2494) !important;}"][vc_column][vc_custom_heading text="``Early on I recognized a need for a professional hand car wash service and auto detail center``.

Lemond B.
Business Owner" font_container="tag:h4|text_align:center|color:%23ffffff" use_theme_fonts="yes" el_class="nt-heading-line"][vc_empty_space][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row content_placement="middle" row_type="row_full_center_content" margin_top="0" padding_top="0" padding_bottom="0" css=".vc_custom_1505341365305{margin-bottom: 0px !important;padding-top: 25px !important;padding-bottom: 0px !important;}"][vc_column css=".vc_custom_1504737946504{padding-right: 10px !important;padding-bottom: 0px !important;}"][vc_column_text]Pro Wash is a professional hand car wash and auto detail center. Pro Wash offers the time efficiency of an express automated car wash with the quality and swirl free paint results of a hand wash. The Pro Wash system allows customers to have a quality hand car wash for a fraction of the time.

We offer an array of service packages from basic hand wash to the extensive master detail package. We also offer consultation and education on basic paint and interior car care. Power washing services are also available and include decks, sidewalks, houses, fleet washing and dealership lot spraying.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="42px"][vc_separator][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row gap="35" row_type="row_full_center_content" margin_top="0" padding_top="0" padding_bottom="0" css=".vc_custom_1750567939658{margin-bottom: 0px !important;padding-top: 25px !important;padding-bottom: 0px !important;background-color: #ffffff !important;}"][vc_column width="2/3" css=".vc_custom_1504737946504{padding-right: 10px !important;padding-bottom: 0px !important;}"][vc_custom_heading text="Send us a quick message" font_container="tag:h2|font_size:28px|text_align:left|color:%23111111" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=""][vc_empty_space height="10px"][contact-form-7 id="4521"][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/3"][vc_custom_heading text="Give us a call" font_container="tag:h2|font_size:28px|text_align:left|color:%23111111" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=""][vc_column_text css=""]301-307-1414

item.title: Sample Page
item.dc:creator: webguys
item.content:encoded:
This is an example page. It's different from a blog post because it will stay in one place and will show up in your site navigation (in most themes). Most people start with an About page that introduces them to potential site visitors. It might say something like this:
Hi there! I'm a bike messenger by day, aspiring actor by night, and this is my website. I live in Los Angeles, have a great dog named Jack, and I like piña coladas. (And gettin' caught in the rain.)
...or something like this:
The XYZ Doohickey Company was founded in 1971, and has been providing quality doohickeys to the public ever since. Located in Gotham City, XYZ employs over 2,000 people and does all kinds of awesome things for the Gotham community.
As a new WordPress user, you should go to your dashboard to delete this page and create new pages for your content. Have fun!

item.title: Refund and Returns Policy
item.dc:creator: webguys
item.content:encoded:
This is a sample page.

Overview

Our refund and returns policy lasts 30 days. If 30 days have passed since your purchase, we can’t offer you a full refund or exchange.

To be eligible for a return, your item must be unused and in the same condition that you received it. It must also be in the original packaging.

Several types of goods are exempt from being returned. Perishable goods such as food, flowers, newspapers or magazines cannot be returned. We also do not accept products that are intimate or sanitary goods, hazardous materials, or flammable liquids or gases.

Additional non-returnable items:

  • Gift cards
  • Downloadable software products
  • Some health and personal care items

To complete your return, we require a receipt or proof of purchase.

Please do not send your purchase back to the manufacturer.

There are certain situations where only partial refunds are granted:

  • Book with obvious signs of use
  • CD, DVD, VHS tape, software, video game, cassette tape, or vinyl record that has been opened.
  • Any item not in its original condition, is damaged or missing parts for reasons not due to our error.
  • Any item that is returned more than 30 days after delivery

Refunds

Once your return is received and inspected, we will send you an email to notify you that we have received your returned item. We will also notify you of the approval or rejection of your refund.

If you are approved, then your refund will be processed, and a credit will automatically be applied to your credit card or original method of payment, within a certain amount of days.

Late or missing refunds

If you haven’t received a refund yet, first check your bank account again.

Then contact your credit card company, it may take some time before your refund is officially posted.

Next contact your bank. There is often some processing time before a refund is posted.

If you’ve done all of this and you still have not received your refund yet, please contact us at {email address}.

Sale items

Only regular priced items may be refunded. Sale items cannot be refunded.

Exchanges

We only replace items if they are defective or damaged. If you need to exchange it for the same item, send us an email at {email address} and send your item to: {physical address}.

Gifts

If the item was marked as a gift when purchased and shipped directly to you, you’ll receive a gift credit for the value of your return. Once the returned item is received, a gift certificate will be mailed to you.

If the item wasn’t marked as a gift when purchased, or the gift giver had the order shipped to themselves to give to you later, we will send a refund to the gift giver and they will find out about your return.

Shipping returns

To return your product, you should mail your product to: {physical address}.

You will be responsible for paying for your own shipping costs for returning your item. Shipping costs are non-refundable. If you receive a refund, the cost of return shipping will be deducted from your refund.

Depending on where you live, the time it may take for your exchanged product to reach you may vary.

If you are returning more expensive items, you may consider using a trackable shipping service or purchasing shipping insurance. We don’t guarantee that we will receive your returned item.

Need help?

Contact us at {email} for questions related to refunds and returns.

Yesterday (Aug 25, 2018) I had a horrible experience at your location in Capitol Heights. First of all about 2 weeks ago I made an appointment online so that my car can be detailed. My appointment was for 9 am since that was the only slot available and I noted that usually via online the Saturday detail slots are only 8 am, 8:30 am, and 9 am.
However, when I showed up for my appointment the manager (Oscar) told me that it is not in the system even though I showed him my online confirmation. Also, on Friday (Aug 24, 2018) I did receive reminders via email and text message. So after debating with Oscar he agreed to detail the car and indicated that it will be ready by 3 pm (if it was taken at 9 am then it would have been completed by 12 pm instead at the later time). Hence, I was already inconvenienced but still decided to leave the car so that the job can be done.
Interestingly, upon my arrival at 3 pm I noticed that the car looked washed but the marks, stains, and scratches were not removed. Also, the car looked as if it was just a basic or regular wash so I thought that they did not detail my car. After speaking with Oscar he said they couldn't do anything about it and maybe it will be best that I spray paint the car. To make matters worse Oscar was telling me that the cost for the job is $135 which was surprising. I told him that I do not have a truck but a car. Hence, the cost is $110 and should be based upon my understanding when booking my appointment. A Lexus RX 350 is a car not a truck.
As a result, this led to a debate between me and Oscar and he then decided to drop the price to $125. I must say that his attitude was horrible and I found him to be very unreasonable. Further, I felt pressured and helpless. Indeed I was very upset and just wanted to get the hell out of establishment instead of creating a scene.
As far as I am aware a Lexus RX 350 is a car and there is sufficient evidence which states this reality. At the end of the day denying my appointment then not being able to do the full job and charging me a truck price instead of a car's is an insult to my intelligence. Honestly, the car was not even cleaned properly especially the inside and I do have pictures to prove it.
Prior to yesterday's appointment my car was once detailed at this location and in comparison to now the difference is between night and day. My vehicle was not detailed and based upon my experience I reflected and thought it best to submit this complaint for reasonable feedback, settlement and for Prowash to do better in the future with its customers. Quite frankly and respectfully but strongly I recommend that customer service training for employees be undertaken at this establishment in Capitol Heights.
Nonetheless, I will never again be doing business with Prowash because of this horrible incident and certainly will not recommend anyone to do the same.
